correctness.rationale: The tangent projector P0Z+ZP0-P0ZP0 fixes E. A(u)=[[1,u],[u,0]] has eigenvalues (1±sqrt(1+4u²))/2, best Frobenius rank-one retraction lambda_plus P_plus, and singular-value gap exactly 1. The exact cost in s=u² has derivative proportional to strictly increasing T_gamma(delta)-q, so threshold q_c=1+gamma/2 yields unique zero below, two symmetric global controls above. Direct expansion gives (q_c-q)s+(2q-1/2)s²+O(s³), quartic at criticality, near-critical split, cost gap and vanishing retraction error; the unreduced cost is strictly convex. Independently confirmed Taylor coefficients and spectral identities.
